critical_code_review_comments: AppLayout.js fetches /mailbox, /subscribe/settings, /company/branding once on mount ([] deps). If a user changes workspace via WorkspaceSwitcher without a full page reload, setupOk flags will not update (they will reflect the previous workspace). Consider re-fetching when the selected company (localStorage clara_company) changes, e.g. via a storage event or a context.
No delete/reset endpoint for company logo; QA cleanup required a direct DB unset. Consider adding DELETE /api/company/logo for parity and test cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily uploaded a 1x1 PNG logo to workspace 6ab3e2fb6d4c335fc26d6cf5 (UITEST_TEST_UI_Brand) to validate positive branding case, then reset company doc via mongo $unset {logo_path, logo_url, logo_version} to restore prior state.
